battle.name: 契丹滅渤海國之戰
battle.brief: 天顯元年（九二六）夏，契丹主耶律阿保機乘渤海王大譚與契丹交惡，會同蕭太妃之謀先發制人，內應開上京龍泉府城門，渤海都城遂陷，大譚被擒送幽州而死，渤海二百二十八年國祚至此而絕，契丹由此獨掌東北。卡面這面羅馬方陣盾從未入中土，交鋒靠的是皮盾、馬槊、撞木與一扇從內打開的城門。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 交戰的兩方，一方是契丹部族聯盟，首領為耶律阿保機；另一方是渤海國，即唐初高句麗遺眾在黑龍江、吉林與朝鮮半島北部建立的國家，君主大氏，世稱忽汗可汗，國都上京龍泉府，後以五京分治。契丹方面的編制是部族聯盟加漢式衙門：阿保機約九一六年建國稱帝，隨後統合契丹八部，收各部帳民為編戶，設南北面官，以耶律氏為皇族，契丹舊俗為本，漢人仕宦者居次；九二六年他親統中軍南下，騎兵為主力，隨軍有從前線州縣編成的漢軍與被俘後編入的丁口，糧秣靠牧地與沿途掠奪，運輸用牛車與駱駝隊。渤海方面是唐式五京十餘府、府下分置數十縣的兵農合一體制，上京龍泉府領縣最多，東京福陵府、中京西都府、西京中京府、南京南海府各領數縣，另有若干都督府；兵以府兵、州兵為骨幹，步兵用唐制長槊、陌刀與弓弩，騎兵承靺鞨、室韋的遊牧射藝，配金屬冑、札甲與馬具，另有編在州縣的舟師，巡行黑龍江口至朝鮮海峽一線。渤海名義上向後唐稱臣受封，國書用漢文，禮制與年號皆循唐式，兩家卻在同一條東北走廊上爭地盤：契丹要控制渤海的人、馬與牧地，渤海則視契丹為西來新患。
countriesEn: The two parties were, on the one side, the confederation of the Khitan tribes led by Yelü Abaoji; on the other, the state of Balhae, raised by the Goguryeo refugees in the Black Dragon river, in Jilin and in the northern half of the Korean peninsula under the Taek clan, whose sovereign was called the hwangeun, with the capital at Longquan in the Upper Capital and a five-capital arrangement afterwards. On the Khitan side the organisation was a tribal confederation dressed in Chinese administrative form: Abaoji proclaimed himself ruler about 916 and then welded the eight Khitan tribes together, registering the households of every tribe, and set up the northern and southern court offices, with the Yelü clan as the imperial house, Khitan custom as the base and Chinese officials of the second rank; in 926 he led the central army south himself, cavalry being the main strength, accompanied by Han troops raised from the frontier prefectures and by captives enrolled as labour, the food coming from the pastures and from plunder on the way, and the baggage carried on ox-carts and camel trains. On the Balhae side was a Tang-style structure of five capitals and more than ten prefectures with a number of counties under each, and a system combining service with farming: Longquan in the Upper Capital governed the most counties, while Fuling in the Eastern Capital, Xidu in the Middle Capital, Zhongjing in the Western Capital and Nanhai in the Southern Capital governed several apiece, beside a number of commanderies. The backbone of the army was the fu and zhou levies, the infantry using Tang-style long spears, glaives, bows and crossbows, the cavalry carrying on the nomadic shooting skill of the Mohe and the Shiwei, with metal helmets, lamellar armour and harness, and there were river squadrons attached to the prefectures, patrolling from the mouth of the Black Dragon river to the Korea straits. Balhae nominally acknowledged the Later Tang and accepted its investiture, its state papers were in Chinese, its ritual and its calendar followed Tang models — and yet the two were contesting the same corridor in the north-east: the Khitan wanted the people, the horses and the pastures of Balhae, while Balhae saw the Khitan as a new enemy coming from the west.
people: 推動這場戰爭的是契丹主耶律阿保機。他是契丹阿保機氏的酋長，出身北方草原部族，約九一六年建國稱帝，統合八部之後卻一直找不到足以與中原抗衡的兵源與城邑，渤海正是那塊跳板；他在位最後一年親統大軍東行，死後廟號太祖，諡號甚長。真正的推手是他的正室蕭太妃：這位蕭氏在契丹宮廷中素以聰斷著稱，據《資治通鑑》與《遼史》，她主張先平渤海再圖河北，並在廢渤海王大譚一事上主導其事，相傳由她遣人刺殺大譚，事後扶立新君充作傀儡。被廢的渤海王大譚是渤海國末代君主，世稱穆宗，在位時對契丹態度強硬，相傳一度中止互市、限制契丹商旅南下，又有意向後唐靠攏；政變之後他本人被押往幽州，途中或在抵京後被殺，屍骨去向無從考證。渤海一方的抵抗並無統一指揮：反對大譚的貴族與軍將在契丹許諾下倒戈，上京龍泉府的城門正是從內部打開的，留下的姓名在史籍中只剩零星數筆。阿保機死後，蕭太妃攝政，以長子耶律倍領渤海故地、封東丹王，以次子耶律德光統契丹本部，兄弟分治的安排正是為了消化剛到手的渤海地盤。另一端的後唐明宗李亶在燕雲與契丹之間本已猶豫，渤海遣使乞師求援而唐廷沒有出兵，此時他正忙於收拾同光三年春天莊宗李存勖留下的朝廷。
peopleEn: The man who drove this war was the Khitan ruler Yelü Abaoji, chief of the Abaoji clan, born into the tribes of the northern steppe. He proclaimed himself ruler about 916 and, after welding the eight tribes together, could find neither the manpower nor the walled cities that would let him stand up to the Central Plain — Balhae was the stepping stone he needed, and in the last year of his reign he led the great army east himself. He was given the temple name Taizu after his death, with a posthumous title of great length. The real hand behind it was his principal wife, the Lady Xiao. This woman of the Xiao clan was noted in the Khitan court for her intelligence and resolve; the Comprehensive Mirror and the History of Liao both have her arguing that Balhae should be settled first and Hebei taken afterwards, and they credit her with the business of deposing the Balhae king Datan, with the tale that she sent men to kill him and then set up a puppet in his place. The king who was deposed, Datan, was the last sovereign of Balhae, known as Muzong. He was hard upon the Khitan while he reigned: it is said that he stopped the mutual trade, restricted the Khitan merchants from moving south, and meant to lean on the Later Tang; after the coup he was escorted to Youzhou and killed on the way or after his arrival, and where his remains went is not known. Balhae offered no united command of its own: nobles and commanders hostile to Datan turned to the Khitan on Khitan promises, and the gate of Longquan in the Upper Capital was opened from inside; of their names almost nothing survives in the records beyond a few stray entries. After Abaoji died, the Lady Xiao took the regency, giving the conquered Balhae lands to his elder son Yelü Bei as king of Dongdan and leaving his second son Yelü Deguang to hold the Khitan homeland — a division of command that existed precisely to digest the newly taken Balhae territory. On the other side, the Later Tang emperor Mingzong, Li Dan, was already wavering between Yanyun and the Khitan; Balhae sent envoys begging for help and the Tang court gave none, and at that moment he was busy settling the court left behind by Li Cunxu, the Zhuangzong, who had died in the spring of the third year of Tongguang.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬方陣盾，學名 scutum，是共和末期成型、帝國時期列為軍需主力的大型步卒盾牌：大略長方形而略作凸面，高約一公尺、闊六七十公分，木板拼製的骨架外面蒙以牛皮與麻布，中央留一個直徑十五至二十公分的鐵盾臍，邊緣以鐵條與皮條加固，淨重約六至七公斤，一手擎持、左手騰出握短矛。它的技術要點正如卡面那句說明：羅馬防線靠盾緣互相咬住，不是靠盾牌本身多厚，整個中隊於是把方盾連成一堵能承受弩箭與投石撞擊的活體城牆。這面盾與渤海、契丹毫無血緣關係：羅馬盾式從未東傳，中原與東北出土的甲兵及文獻中找不到相應形制，渤海與契丹的盾是木胎蒙革的本地款式，多為圓盾與方盾，前排步兵持盾結陣、配長槊與弓箭，契丹騎兵用的是更小便於挽弓的弓盾。真正上陣的攻城與守禦器械集中在別處：渤海以土築城垣配合坊牆與木柵，弓弩自城頭覆蓋，騎兵在城郊反擊；契丹方面器械相對簡陋，用撞木撞門、火燒門樓、雲梯與壕塹阻騎兵突襲，再輔以內應開城，輔助兵種與攻城手段都不足以硬攻唐式城郭，而渤海恰恰是靠唐式城防立國。渤海與契丹真正大量裝備的是弓箭、馬槊、長刀、皮甲與札甲，契丹的角弓與短箭配皮革甲胄與套馬索最為耐用，渤海另有巡行朝鮮海峽的舟師與運糧牛車隊。換句話說，卡面這面盾在此處是一塊對照用的標尺：它標示出盾牆這一技術在世界其他戰場上已成熟的樣子，也標示出渤海與契丹靠的是皮盾、木盾與內應，而不是任何形似羅馬的裝備。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman scutum, a large infantry shield that took shape in the late Republic and stood as a main item of the imperial supply: broadly rectangular and slightly convex, about a metre high and sixty to seventy centimetres wide, its plank-built frame covered with ox hide and linen, with an iron boss of some fifteen to twenty centimetres diameter left in the centre and the edges reinforced with iron and hide strips, its weight some six to seven kilograms, carried in one hand so that the left was left free to hold a short spear. Its technical point is exactly the one given in the card's line: the Roman line held because shield edge gripped shield edge, not because any single shield was thick, and a whole century of men would link the rectangles into a living wall able to take a bolt or a stone from a siege engine. This shield had no blood kinship with Balhae or with the Khitan: the Roman shield form never travelled east, and nothing corresponding to it appears among the excavated arms or the documents of the Central Plain and the north-east; the shields of Balhae and of the Khitan were local types, a plank frame covered with hide, mostly round and rectangular shields, the front rank of the infantry holding them in a close line with long spears and bows, while the Khitan horse used a smaller bow-shield that left the hands free for the bow. The equipment actually in the field lay elsewhere: Balhae relied on earthen ramparts with ward walls and timber palisades, bows and crossbows covering from the wall-head, and horse striking back on the open ground outside the walls; the Khitan were comparatively poor in machinery, using a battering beam against the gate, fire against the gate-tower, ladders, and a ditch dug to keep the horse out, backed by an insider opening the gate — their auxiliary troops and their means of siege were simply not enough to batter a Tang-style city wall, and Balhae was precisely a state founded on Tang-style defences. What the two sides carried in bulk was the bow and arrow, the long spear, the sword, hide and lamellar armour; the Khitan short composite bow with its short arrow, leather armour and lasso was the most durable thing they had, and Balhae had in addition the river squadron patrolling the Korea straits and the ox-cart teams that brought the grain. Put another way, the shield on the card is a measuring rod laid against the case: it shows what the shield-wall had already become on other battlefields of the world, and it shows that what Balhae and the Khitan had was hide and timber and an insider, and nothing resembling a Roman kit.
tactics: 契丹的整套打法由三段組成：先斷外援，再策內變，最後以奇兵取城。渤海王大譚既已向後唐求援，契丹必須在唐廷反應之前把事情了結，於是阿保機先廢大譚以絕其號令，斷絕渤海貴族藉大譚名義外援的路子；隨後大軍自契丹本部臨潢一帶出發，東出而南，穿越松花江下游與牡丹江上游的丘陵地帶，直撲上京龍泉府。行軍刻意求快，隊形以輕騎為先鋒、步卒與攻城雜役隨其後，糧秣主要靠沿途掠奪與牧地解決，遇大軍集結就散成游騎，避免被渤海騎兵咬住。五京分守的格局對契丹有利：渤海領地南北縱跨千里，上京與東京、中京之間隔著高句麗故地與山嶺，訊息靠驛騎傳遞需數日，契丹卻是全軍集中在同一條攻擊軸上，渤海無法在數日之內把兵力收攏到首都。城破的關鍵在城門之內：渤海朝中反大譚的貴族與軍將被收買，城門由內打開，契丹精騎在黎明前突入，步卒隨後登城奪門，上京守軍在指揮混亂中崩散，後續諸府未及整軍即相繼歸降。渤海的部署本身並不荒唐：城頭弓弩壓制、坊牆節節抵抗、盾兵結陣守門、騎兵在城郊掩護，都是唐式守城的常規；問題在於大譚被廢之後命令系統已斷，誰該守、守多久、援兵在哪裡都無人能答，忠誠在一夜之間變成需要計算的東西。契丹攻城的另一個弱點是器械：他們沒有大型砲具與攻城塔，只能靠撞木、火攻與內應，硬攻唐式城郭代價太高；也正因如此，渤海亡國的速度快得驚人，與其說是被攻城器械摧毀，不如說是被自己人的手從門內打開。
tacticsEn: The Khitan method had three stages: cut off outside help, then work the treachery inside, and finally take the city by surprise. Since Datan had already appealed to the Later Tang, the Khitan had to finish the business before the Tang court could react, so Abaoji first deposed Datan to cut off the road by which the Balhae nobles might call in aid in the king's name; then the great army set out from Linhuang in the Khitan homeland, moved east and then south, crossed the hills of the lower Sungari and the upper Mudan, and drove straight at Longquan in the Upper Capital. The march was made deliberately fast, the order of march putting light horse in the van and the foot and the siege train behind, the food coming mainly from what was taken on the way and from the pastures, and the formation scattering into loose horse whenever a mass of enemy horse came up, so as not to be caught by the Balhae cavalry. The five-capital layout worked for the Khitan: the Balhae realm ran a thousand li north to south, with the old country of Goguryeo and its mountains between the Upper, Middle and Eastern Capitals, and messages carried by relay horse taking days to travel, while the Khitan had their whole army on a single axis of attack, so that Balhae could not gather its forces at the capital within a few days. The key to the city lay inside the gate: nobles and commanders of the Balhae court hostile to Datan were bought, the gate was opened from within, Khitan picked horse went in before dawn and the foot followed them up the wall to seize the gates, the garrison of the Upper Capital broke up amid a confused command, and the other prefectures surrendered one after another without getting their troops in order. The Balhae deployment was not in itself absurd: bows and crossbows from the wall-head, ward walls fighting in section, shield-men closed up at the gates, horse covering the open ground outside — all of it the ordinary repertoire of a Tang-style defence. The trouble was that after Datan was deposed the chain of command was broken: who should hold, how long, and where the relief was could be answered by no one, and loyalty became something to be calculated overnight. The other weakness of the Khitan lay in their siege machinery: they had no great artillery and no siege towers, and could only use the battering beam, fire and the insider; a frontal assault on a Tang-style wall was too costly to pay, and it was for exactly that reason that the fall of Balhae was startlingly quick — less destroyed by siege engines than opened from within by its own people.
data: 能核實的數字有限，餘下的只能說個大概。渤海自698年大祚榮建國到926年國破，立國二百二十八年，是唐初高句麗降民在黑龍江流域重建的產物，五京為上京龍泉府（今黑龍江寧安）、中京西都府（今吉林延吉一帶）、東京福陵府（今遼寧撫順）、西京中京府（今吉林長白）、南京南海府（今遼寧南部）；領地北抵黑龍江下游，南至今朝鮮半島中部的浿水江流域，鼎盛時人口在數十萬至數百萬之量級，遣使入唐朝貢逾百次。戰役本身缺少兵員數字：正史只以「大軍」「精甲」一類概語形容契丹出兵，渤海上京守軍的數目亦無記載，僅可依五京分守、領地縱貫千里推知，渤海無力在首都集結數萬人，契丹能集中的騎兵當在數萬之數但無法確證。距離方面，契丹本部臨潢至上京龍泉府道路險遠，約近千里，輕騎十餘日可至，步卒與攻城雜役拖成數十里長的縱隊；自上京至幽州押送大譚的道路約二千餘里，押解隊伍走的是陸路，耗時以月計。時間上，政變與出兵同在九二六年，年內阿保機病逝，蕭太妃攝政，翌年耶律德光即位，再一年國號改為大遼，渤海故地則於九二八年設東丹國治之。卡面兵器本身也有尺寸可說：羅馬方陣盾高約一公尺、闊六七十公分、重約六至七公斤，盾臍直徑約十五至二十公分，是同時代歐洲步卒最重的常備防護之一。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, and the rest can only be given roughly. Balhae was founded by Dae Joyeong in 698 and perished in 926, a run of two hundred and twenty-eight years, the work of Goguryeo's fugitives re-founded in the Black Dragon river basin. Its five capitals were Longquan in the Upper Capital (today Ning'an in Heilongjiang), Xidu in the Middle Capital (in the Yanji area of Jilin), Fuling in the Eastern Capital (today Fushun in Liaoning), Zhongjing in the Western Capital (today Changbai in Jilin) and Nanhai in the Southern Capital (in southern Liaoning). Its territory reached the lower Black Dragon river in the north and the Apnong river in the middle of the Korean peninsula in the south, its population at its height lying somewhere between tens of thousands and several hundreds of thousands, and it sent more than a hundred missions to the Tang court. The battle itself has no figures of men: the histories describe the Khitan host only in general terms, as a great army and picked armour, and the number of the garrison of Longquan is nowhere recorded; from the five-capital defence and the thousand-li reach of the realm one can only infer that Balhae could not concentrate tens of thousands at the capital, and that the Khitan cavalry they could concentrate was in the tens of thousands, though this cannot be confirmed. On distances, the road from Linhuang in the Khitan homeland to Longquan in the Upper Capital was long and rough and something close to a thousand li: light horse could cover it in a little over ten days, while the foot and the siege train stretched into a column tens of li deep; the road carrying Datan from the Upper Capital to Youzhou ran some two thousand li, and the escort went by land, taking the count in months. On timing, the coup and the march both fall in 926, in which year Abaoji fell ill and died, the Lady Xiao took the regency, Yelü Deguang came to the throne the following year, the state name was changed to Liao the year after that, and the old Balhae lands were administered as Dongdan from 928. The weapon on the card has dimensions of its own: the Roman scutum was about a metre high, sixty to seventy centimetres wide and six to seven kilograms heavy, with a boss of some fifteen to twenty centimetres across, and was among the heaviest routine protections of the European infantry of its day.
cause: 打起來有遠因，也有近因。遠因是東北走廊的生存空間：契丹統合八部之後，牧場向西的草原因中原混戰而漸趨飽和，向東則面對渤海這個有城、有農、有馬，又有唐式政體的國家，渤海控制的牡丹江、松花江下游與遼東沿線，恰好卡在契丹人馬南下的路上；渤海則需要黑龍江口的鹽、漁獲、鐵料與通往新羅、日本的航路，兩家都要，衝突因此幾乎不可避免。近因是渤海王大譚的對策與渤海內部的裂痕。大譚對契丹態度強硬，相傳中止互市、限制契丹商旅南下，又向後唐求援打算借中原之力牽制契丹，這對阿保機是無法容忍的威脅：契丹若失去渤海，等於把東北的大門與全部人力拱手讓出。蕭太妃由此得出戰略主張：先取渤海，則河北可圖；若在渤海未平時貿然南下，勝負未可知，河北有中原主力，渤海有內應可乘，兩相比較，先取渤海代價小而收穫實。渤海王室的君臣矛盾是關鍵的另一半：大譚在位多年，貴族與邊將對他的強硬外交並不滿意，一旦外部強敵出現，內部即有人願意與契丹合作，於是城門從裡面打開。歸根結柢，這是一場用一次政變換取一個國家的戰爭，渤海輸在人心與號令，而不是輸在戰鬥。
causeEn: There was a distant cause and an immediate one. The distant cause was the living space of the north-east corridor: once the Khitan had welded the eight tribes together, their pastures to the west were filling up as the Central Plain fought itself out, and to the east they faced Balhae, a country with cities, fields, horses and a Tang-style polity, whose control of the Mudan, of the lower Sungari and of the line of Liaodong stood exactly across the road by which Khitan men and horses would go south; Balhae in turn needed the salt, the fishing, the iron and the sea road to Silla and Japan, and both wanted what the other held, so the clash was very nearly unavoidable. The immediate cause was the Balhae king's own policy and the cracks inside the state. Datan was hard on the Khitan, and it is said that he stopped the mutual trade, restricted the Khitan merchants and turned to the Later Tang for help in order to hold the Khitan down; to Abaoji that was an intolerable threat, for losing Balhae would mean handing over the great gate of the north-east and the whole manpower of it. The Lady Xiao drew the strategic conclusion from this: take Balhae first, and Hebei may be taken; to march south while Balhae was still unmastered was a contest of uncertain result, for Hebei was held by the main force of the Central Plain while Balhae had an insider to be used, and of the two the first cost less and brought more certain gain. The conflict between the Balhae royal house and its nobles was the other half of the key: Datan's long years of a hard foreign policy had left the nobles and the frontier commanders dissatisfied, and once a strong outside enemy appeared, some of them were willing to work with the Khitan — and so the gate was opened from inside. In the end this was a war in which one coup was exchanged for a whole country: Balhae lost on hearts and on command, not on the field of battle.
impact: 渤海亡國是東北歷史的轉折，也是契丹真正成為東亞強權的起點。契丹得到的不只是一座城：渤海舊地提供了黑龍江與松花江流域的農地、牧場、鐵冶與城鎮樣式，渤海人則被整批編入契丹各部或徙往遼東，與原有部眾混居，契丹由此獲得第一批成建制的中原農耕人口，阿保機也才有本錢在幾年後南下爭燕雲。政權安排隨之展開：九二八年設東丹國，以耶律倍為王、遼陽為都，把渤海舊地與遼東合在一起託管，耶律德光則坐鎮本部，兄弟分治正是蕭太妃穩住新地盤的手法；此後契丹國號改為大遼，渤海舊地成為經營東北的基地，遼的東北經營一路延伸到金朝代立。對朝鮮半島而言，渤海自698年以來對新羅的長期壓力就此解除，新羅得以在九三〇年代完成最後統一，渤海遺民也有流亡入新羅者，把渤海官制、樂舞與文字層帶入三韓史，成為統一前夕的一段過渡。往南看，契丹手上的燕雲十六州與渤海的人力畜力疊加在一起，才有了936年石敬瑭割地、遼軍南下、947年滅後晉的連續動作，中原的格局因而被重寫。回頭看卡面那面羅馬方陣盾，倒有一層象徵意味：羅馬的盾牆靠制度化的兵員、操練與互信撐住前線，盾緣能咬住是因為後面站著一整個可靠的軍團；渤海同樣有制度、有城、有器械，卻在一場宮廷政變之後連自己的門都守不住。制度與忠誠不是同一件事，盾牌的厚度從來不是決定戰爭的東西。
impactEn: The fall of Balhae was a turning point in the history of the north-east and the point at which the Khitan truly became a power in East Asia. What the Khitan gained was not merely a city: the old Balhae lands gave them farmland, pasture, iron-working and towns along the Black Dragon and Sungari rivers, and the Balhae people were enrolled wholesale into the Khitan tribes or moved east to Liaodong, mingling with the populations already there, so that the Khitan gained their first large body of settled farming folk; only then did Abaoji have the wherewithal to contest Yanyun a few years later. The political arrangement followed: Dongdan was set up in 928 with Yelü Bei as its king and Liaoyang as its seat, holding the old Balhae country and Liaodong together, while Yelü Deguang sat in the homeland — the division between brothers being the Lady Xiao's way of holding the new ground steady; afterwards the state took the name Liao, the old Balhae country became a base for governing the north-east, and that work went on until the Jin replaced the Liao. For the Korean peninsula, the long pressure that Balhae had exerted on Silla since 698 came to an end, Silla was able to complete its final unification in the 930s, and Balhae refugees who fled into Silla carried the Balhae officialdom, music and writing into the history of the Three Han, becoming a layer of the eve of unification. To the south, the Sixteen Prefectures of Yanyun and the manpower and stock of Balhae stacked together, and only then did the sequence of 936, when Shi Jingtang ceded the ground, of the Liao armies marching south and of 947, when the Later Jin was destroyed, become possible; the pattern of the Central Plain was rewritten. Looking back at the Roman scutum on the card, there is a pointed meaning in it: the Roman shield-wall was held up by institutionalised manpower, drill and mutual trust, and the edges could grip because a whole reliable army stood behind them; Balhae had institutions, walls and equipment too, and after a palace coup could not even hold its own gate. Institution and loyalty are not the same thing, and the thickness of a shield was never what decided a war.
result: 結果簡單：渤海亡國。契丹攻陷上京龍泉府，渤海王大譚被擒，押送幽州後被殺，國祚自698年大祚榮建國至此共二百二十八年，五京與其間的府縣陸續歸降，渤海作為獨立政權在東北存在了兩個多世紀，最後以城門內應的方式終結。收尾也在同年：阿保機於九二六年秋病卒，廟號太祖，蕭太妃以攝政身份立耶律德光為帝、耶律倍為東丹王，把新得的地盤與舊有的人口分開安頓；九三八年國號改為大遼，渤海故地自此成為遼的一部分，直到金滅遼為止。渤海人並沒有消失：留居舊地者改隸州縣，徙往遼東者編入契丹各部與漢人戶籍，成為後來契丹人、漢人乃至女真血統裡的一支，渤海式鐵冶、造船與農耕技術也隨之進入契丹社會。對新羅與高句麗餘民來說，渤海之亡是一個時代的終結，也是朝鮮半島統一前夜的一次清場。就卡面兵器而言，可以確定的只有一句：羅馬方陣盾與這場戰爭無涉，它不曾越過中亞到達渤海，這一役真正決定勝負的是蕭太妃的政變、大譚的倒台與城門內應，而不是任何一件奇技之器。
resultEn: The result is simple: Balhae ceased to exist. The Khitan took Longquan in the Upper Capital, the Balhae king Datan was taken alive, escorted to Youzhou and killed, and the state founded by Dae Joyeong in 698 came to an end after two hundred and twenty-eight years; the five capitals and the prefectures between them surrendered one after another, and Balhae had stood as an independent power in the north-east for more than two centuries, only to end with a gate opened from within. The tidying-up came in the same year: Abaoji fell ill and died in the autumn of 926 and was given the temple name Taizu; the Lady Xiao as regent installed Yelü Deguang as emperor and Yelü Bei as king of Dongdan, settling the new land and the old population in two separate arrangements; in 938 the state took the name Liao, and the old Balhae country became part of it until the Jin destroyed the Liao. The Balhae people did not disappear: those who stayed on the old soil were entered on the registers of the prefectures, those moved east to Liaodong were enrolled in the Khitan tribes and the Han households, and they became one strand in the later ancestry of the Khitan, the Han and the Jurchen, taking Balhae iron-working, boatbuilding and farming into Khitan society as they went. For Silla and for the surviving Goguryeo, the end of Balhae closed an age and cleared the ground on the eve of the unification of the Korean peninsula. As for the weapon on the card, only one thing can be said with certainty: the Roman scutum had nothing to do with this war and never crossed Central Asia to reach Balhae, and what decided the outcome was the coup of the Lady Xiao, the fall of Datan and the gate opened from within, and not any marvel-weapon whatsoever.
